title: Production Postgres credential is public: bundled in every APK and committed to a public GitHub branch
locations: pubspec.yaml:40 (.env declared as a Flutter asset)
evidence: `unzip -l build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk` lists assets/flutter_assets/.env (206 bytes) — reproduced this session
`git merge-base --is-ancestor <c> origin/entire/checkpoints/v1` true for both commits; `git ls-remote origin` shows the branch live
`gh repo view` reports the repository visibility as PUBLIC
`git grep` on those commits finds the database host and owner role name inside agent-transcript JSONL
impact: Anyone who downloads the APK or browses the public branch obtains owner-level read/write access to the shared production database containing every user's transactions, raw SMS text and geolocation.
actual_behavior: DATABASE_URL (with password) ships in plaintext inside the APK and is readable on GitHub.
expected_behavior: No database credential reaches the client or version control.
validation: Static + artifact inspection + git/GitHub queries. Secret value deliberately not reproduced in this report.
recommended_fix: 1) Rotate the Neon password/role immediately. 2) Delete or rewrite refs/heads/entire/checkpoints/v1 on origin (requires force-push; owner decision) and purge caches. 3) Stop shipping .env as an asset; move sync behind an authenticated API (see S2). 4) Stop committing agent transcripts (.entire) to pushed branches.
documentation_impact: docs/setup.md acknowledges credentials ship in the APK but presents it as a note, not a vulnerability; must be reworded once fixed.
status: OPEN — requires owner action (rotation, history rewrite)

title: No server tier: the mobile client connects directly to Postgres; all installs write one shared, unpartitioned table
evidence: Remote `transactions` DDL has no user_id/device_id column; upsert keyed only on record UUID
On-device DB pulled via `run-as`: all 118 local rows have synced=1 — the owner's real transactions are in the shared database
impact: Any install can read, modify or delete every other install's financial records; credential cannot be revoked per device.
actual_behavior: Shared DB credential embedded in client; no authentication or authorization layer.
expected_behavior: Per-user authenticated API with server-side authorization; database never reachable from clients.
recommended_fix: Introduce an API (e.g. serverless function) with per-user auth and row ownership; until then disable sync (SYNC_ENABLED=false) and remove .env from assets.
documentation_impact: docs/architecture.md and docs/features/sync.md should state the trust model explicitly.

title: Captured SMS bodies and payment notifications were broadcast to every app on the device
evidence: Both use `sendBroadcast(Intent(ACTION))` with no setPackage() and no receiver permission
MainActivity.kt:53 already uses setPackage() for the widget broadcast, so the safe pattern was known
The notification allowlist includes com.whatsapp, so WhatsApp chat notifications were included
impact: Any installed app registering a runtime receiver for com.upitracker.app.SMS_RECEIVED/NOTIFICATION_RECEIVED receives every SMS (incl. OTPs) without READ_SMS.
actual_behavior: Implicit, system-wide broadcast of message content.
expected_behavior: Package-scoped delivery to the app's own receiver only.
validation: Static. Not demonstrated with a third-party receiver (deliberately not built). Runtime-registered receivers still receive implicit broadcasts on Android 8+.
recommended_fix: setPackage(packageName) on both intents — APPLIED.
documentation_impact: docs/android/native-layer.md and platform-channels.md described these as 'internal' broadcasts; that is now accurate.

title: Full SMS and notification text written to logcat in all build types
evidence: `Log.d(TAG, "SMS from $sender: $body")` with no debug guard; release build has no R8/ProGuard rules
impact: Bank SMS, OTPs and (via the WhatsApp allowlist entry) chat messages are exposed to anyone with adb/logcat access and to bug-report captures.
recommended_fix: Log only lengths/package names — APPLIED.

title: Release builds are signed with the debug keystore
evidence: `release { signingConfig = signingConfigs.getByName("debug") }`
impact: Release artifacts are not distributable and can be re-signed/replaced by anyone holding the public debug key.
expected_behavior: Dedicated release keystore kept out of the repo.
recommended_fix: Add a release signingConfig reading keystore path/passwords from local properties or CI secrets.
documentation_impact: docs/android/native-layer.md states this; keep until fixed.

title: Android backup enabled for a database of raw SMS text and geotags
evidence: `dumpsys package com.example.receipt` shows ALLOW_BACKUP on the device
After the fix, the reinstalled com.upitracker.app no longer reports ALLOW_BACKUP
impact: Transaction history, raw bank SMS and locations are copied to cloud backup / device transfer outside the app's control.
validation: Verified on device before and after.
recommended_fix: allowBackup=false, fullBackupContent=false, dataExtractionRules excluding all domains — APPLIED.

title: Debt ledger exported unencrypted to world-readable shared storage, requiring the Play-restricted MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
evidence: Hard-coded public Documents path; plaintext JSON of names, amounts, reasons, notes
Restore banner reads the same file on every Debts visit; after reinstall Android 11+ no longer treats the app as owner, so restore also depends on the restricted permission
export() had no error handling; readBackup() returned null for corrupt files (indistinguishable from 'no backup')
impact: Other apps with storage access can read the ledger; the permission is likely to block Play publication.
expected_behavior: App-private storage, no broad storage permission, explicit error reporting.
recommended_fix: Moved to getExternalStorageDirectory() (app-specific, no permission), removed both storage permissions, added DebtBackupException for write/corrupt-read failures — APPLIED. Trade-off: the backup no longer survives uninstall; SAF (user-chosen location) is the alternative if that matters.

title: Precise per-purchase geolocation is synced to the shared, credential-exposed database
evidence: latitude/longitude at full precision plus reverse-geocoded place name are in the remote upsert parameter map
impact: Combined with S1/S2, a public location history of the user's purchases.
expected_behavior: Location kept local or coarsened, and only synced with consent.
recommended_fix: Exclude or coarsen location fields in sync; make location tagging opt-in.
documentation_impact: docs/features/location-tagging.md should state it is synced.

title: TLS to Postgres does not verify the server certificate; channel_binding is dropped
evidence: SslMode.require (encrypt, no verification) is used; the hand-written URL parser ignores query parameters such as channel_binding=require
impact: A network attacker can MITM the database connection and capture the credential.
recommended_fix: Use SslMode.verifyFull; better, remove direct DB access (S2).

title: Widget provider exported without a permission
evidence: Accepts com.upitracker.app.UPDATE_WIDGET from any app
impact: Any app can force widget re-renders (no data exposure).
recommended_fix: Drop the custom action from the exported filter (MainActivity already sends it package-scoped) or protect it with a signature permission.

title: Real bank SMS (account suffix, PAN fragment, balances, reference numbers, third-party names) committed to the public repository
evidence: `git grep` on origin/main finds the owner's account-suffix pattern in 17 files and real 12-digit reference numbers in 13
Full names of real counterparties with amounts appear in 10 files on main
The checkpoint branch contains further raw SMS content
.gitignore explicitly excludes data/*.csv 'because they contain real SMS / personal data' — the same content was copied into fixtures
impact: Personal financial data of the owner and identifying data of third parties is publicly readable.
actual_behavior: Real messages used as test data.
validation: git grep against origin/main and the checkpoint branch.
recommended_fix: Replace fixtures with synthetic messages preserving format; rewrite history or make the repository private (owner decision).
documentation_impact: data/README.md should state the rule applies to fixtures too.

title: Unused privileged permissions declared
evidence: RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED and FOREGROUND_SERVICE are declared; no boot receiver or foreground service exists
impact: Larger permission surface than needed.
validation: grep of manifest and Kotlin sources.
recommended_fix: Remove both, or implement the boot/foreground capture they imply (see C1).

title: Entire CLI git hooks copy session transcripts into a branch and push them with every push
evidence: post-commit condenses session data into the checkpoint branch when a commit carries an Entire-Checkpoint trailer; pre-push pushes those logs alongside the user's push
This mechanism produced S1 and part of S11
Unpushed local entire branches already contain this audit session's transcripts with the owner's account-suffix pattern (122 matches) and real reference numbers (67)
impact: Every future push can republish secrets and personal data from AI-assisted sessions to the public repository.
expected_behavior: Session logs never leave the machine, or are scrubbed first.
validation: Hook scripts read; git grep on local entire branches.
recommended_fix: Owner: uninstall or reconfigure the Entire hooks (or disable its push); delete the local entire/* branches before the next push. Audit commits were made with hooks disabled.
status: OPEN — owner action before next push

title: Live capture is never running: Live Monitoring is a non-persisted per-session switch, and nothing is captured or caught up while the app is closed
evidence: startListening() is only called from the Settings switch; _isListening defaults to false and is not persisted
Native receivers forward to Dart only while MainActivity's dynamic receivers are registered; no queue
Device: app database holds 118 rows, all source=sms, all created in a single manual history scan; latest transaction ~2.5 months old; zero notification-sourced rows ever

Device: after launch the dashboard shows ₹0 / 0 transactions for the last 24h while the inbox has bank debits from the same day; Settings shows Live Monitoring OFF directly under 'Notification Access: Granted — listening to UPI app notifications'
impact: The core feature — automatic capture — does not work in normal use; this is the primary cause of the reported 'broken' behaviour.
actual_behavior: Capture only while the user has manually flipped the switch in the current process; everything else lost.
expected_behavior: Capture enabled by default and resumed after restarts; missed SMS recovered.
validation: Device database inspection, UI dump, code trace.
recommended_fix: APPLIED: persisted Live Monitoring preference (default on), auto-start on launch after models load, silent SMS catch-up from a persisted timestamp watermark, onError handling, truthful settings copy. REMAINING: notifications that arrive while the app is not running are still lost (needs a native persistent queue or a foreground service).
documentation_impact: docs/features/transaction-capture.md and README 'real time' claim updated.

title: Classifiers silently drop entire real-world bank SMS templates (incoming credits, UPI Lite top-ups)
evidence: Sweep of the owner's 3,901-message inbox through the shipped models (corpus kept outside the repo): 1,781 UPI-related, 287 dropped at spam, 206 at transactional

Ground truth via DLT service headers + RRN: 12 real transactions dropped (₹14,146.07): every 'Your A/c *XXXX is credited with Rs.Y … RRN …' credit (7/7, p_tx 0.42–0.44) and every 'debited and Rs.Y added to your UPI Lite on npci App. RRN…' top-up (5/5, p_spam = 0.85 exactly at threshold)
Docs/README claim '100% ingested' — true only on the 382-message training corpus
Recall on bank/UPI service-header transactions was 98.8% overall, so the failure is template-specific, not global
impact: Incoming money in the affected formats never appears in the ledger.
actual_behavior: Model veto overrides hard settlement evidence.
expected_behavior: Messages proving a settled payment are never dropped by a probabilistic gate.
validation: Real-inbox sweep before/after (harness outside the repo).
recommended_fix: APPLIED: settlement-evidence rule — 12-digit RRN/UTR/UPI Ref + settlement verb from a DLT-registered header (or an allowlisted notification) bypasses the model veto. Re-sweep: exactly the 12 real transactions rescued, 0 previously-ingested messages dropped, no scam/mandate/collect message rescued. Retraining on real-inbox data was rejected because it would embed personal tokens in shipped weights.
documentation_impact: docs/features/ml-pipeline.md documents the rule; README '100%' claim qualified.

title: UPI Lite top-ups recorded as income (wrong sign)
evidence: Credit keywords are matched first by substring; 'added to' (credit list) fires before 'debited' in 'A/c debited and Rs.X added to your UPI Lite'
Inbox sweep: 26 ingested messages flipped from credit to debit after the fix, all UPI Lite top-ups, ₹36,951.46 previously counted as received
Direction-model disagreements fell from 5 to 1 after the fix
impact: Spending under-reported and income over-reported by the top-up amounts.
expected_behavior: 'debited'/'credited' (account settlement verbs) take precedence, earliest wins.
validation: Inbox sweep before/after; 3 regression tests, 2 of which fail on the old parser.
recommended_fix: APPLIED.

title: Model load was fire-and-forget (latent race with fail-open classifiers)
evidence: `unawaited(MessagePipeline.instance.load())`; unloaded classifiers return spam=0.0, tx=true
Device measurement: all three models load in 161 ms (debug build) — unreachable in practice while capture required a manual toggle, but reachable once capture auto-starts (C1 fix)
impact: Messages evaluated during the window would bypass all filtering.
recommended_fix: APPLIED: initialize() awaits load() before starting capture.

title: Classifier load failure is completely silent
evidence: Exceptions (incl. StateError for corrupt models) are caught and only debugPrinted; no UI anywhere showed load state
impact: If loading ever fails the app ingests spam/OTPs as transactions with no signal.
expected_behavior: Fail-open is reasonable, but must be visible.
validation: Static; new tests prove missing/corrupt assets leave the engine unloaded.
recommended_fix: APPLIED: MessagePipeline.isLoaded / provider.filtersLoaded surfaced in Settings.

title: SMS history scan only reaches the 500 most recent SMS of any sender
evidence: readSmsHistory(limit: 500) without `since`; inbox on device has 3,901 messages
impact: Older transactions can never be imported.
recommended_fix: Partially mitigated by the persisted catch-up watermark (C1); full-history import still needs paging off the main thread (see P2).

title: History scan also ingests sent/outbox SMS
evidence: Query covers all SMS types; the Dart side never checked `type`
impact: User's own outgoing messages can be parsed as transactions.
recommended_fix: APPLIED: skip non-inbox rows.

title: EventChannel errors silently kill capture while the UI still reports 'listening'
evidence: listen() without onError
impact: Capture stops permanently with no indication.
recommended_fix: APPLIED: onError stops listening and reports the error.

title: SYNC_INTERVAL_MINUTES of 0 or less spins Timer.periodic
evidence: int.tryParse('0') returns 0, so the `?? 15` fallback never applies
impact: Tight sync loop hammering the database and battery.
recommended_fix: APPLIED.

title: Un-settling a debt leaves a stale settled_at
evidence: copyWith treats null as 'keep'
impact: Inconsistent rows (settled=0 with settled_at set).
recommended_fix: APPLIED: explicit clearSettledAt flag.
documentation_impact: docs/data/models.md listed it as a quirk.

title: Widget 24h transaction count used the filtered list while amounts were unfiltered
evidence: _last24hCount derived from _transactions (user filters applied)
impact: Widget count disagrees with its own totals when filters are active.
recommended_fix: APPLIED: count from the database for the same window.

title: Percent-encoded credentials in DATABASE_URL were not decoded
evidence: userInfo used raw
impact: Passwords containing %XX fail to authenticate.
recommended_fix: APPLIED.

title: Startup crashes if .env is absent
evidence: dotenv.load without isOptional
impact: Removing the bundled .env (S1/S2 fix) would crash the app.
recommended_fix: APPLIED: isOptional: true.

title: Local and remote disagree on transaction instants
evidence: SQLite stores naive local ISO strings; Postgres receives DateTime into TIMESTAMPTZ
impact: Timestamps shift if the device time zone changes; local date filters use lexicographic string comparison.
recommended_fix: Store UTC (or epoch ms) locally.

title: Dedup can merge genuinely distinct payments
evidence: Body-hash fallback for ref-less messages; fuzzy tier treats an empty counterparty as compatible; same-day path ignores time
impact: Two identical small payments (same amount/day, unparsed counterparty) can collapse into one.
recommended_fix: Require a discriminator (time, balance, ref) before merging.

title: Sync integrity check has blind spots and swallows errors
evidence: Count comparison masked by other devices' rows; only first/last ids probed; catch(_) returns 'ok'
impact: Remote data loss can go undetected.
recommended_fix: Compare per-id checksums in pages; surface errors.

title: Dead Postgres connection is cached forever; no timeout or retry
evidence: _connection reused until close(); no reset on error
impact: After a server-side disconnect every sync fails until restart. (Settings showed 'Syncing…' with 'Not synced yet' right after launch on device; root cause not isolated.)
recommended_fix: Reset _connection on error; add timeouts.

title: MainActivity leaks receivers and orphans them on re-subscribe
evidence: Receivers unregistered only in onCancel; no onDestroy cleanup; second onListen overwrites the field
impact: IntentReceiverLeaked / duplicate deliveries.
recommended_fix: Unregister in cleanUpFlutterEngine and before re-registering.

title: SMS permission denial is reported as 'No new transactions found'
evidence: SecurityException → PlatformException → catch(_) → []
impact: Users cannot distinguish a permission problem from an empty inbox.
validation: Static; on-device revoke test not run (device was in use).
recommended_fix: Propagate a typed error.

title: Home widget shows stale figures with no staleness signal
evidence: Data is pushed only while the Dart isolate runs; updatedAt stored but never rendered
impact: After a day without opening the app the widget presents old 'Last 24 hours' totals as current.
validation: Static. The 'can't load widget' error from commit db4fc0a was not reproduced (device in use).
recommended_fix: Render updatedAt / hide when older than 24h.

title: Notification allowlist misses installed payment apps and includes WhatsApp
evidence: Device: SBI (com.sbi.lotusintouch), super.money, Navi, PhonePe Business and Amazon are installed but not allowlisted
Three allowlisted ids look wrong (net.csam.hdfc, com.canaaborb, com.myairtel.myairtelapp) — not verified against the Play Store
com.whatsapp is allowlisted, so chat notifications enter the pipeline without the SMS-path isUpiRelated pre-gate
impact: Missed notification transactions; possible false transactions from chats.
recommended_fix: Fix ids; drop WhatsApp or gate it on payment-specific text.

title: TransactionType/DebtDirection silently default unknown values
evidence: Unknown → debit / owedToMe
impact: Corrupt rows flip sign silently.
recommended_fix: Throw or log.

title: TransactionRecord.copyWith cannot clear nullable fields
evidence: `note ?? this.note`
impact: A note cannot be cleared to null (empty string works).
recommended_fix: Same pattern as C10.

title: Labelled sparkline bars overflow the dashboard card
evidence: The tallest bar takes the full 56 px LayoutBuilder height and the amount label is stacked above it in a Column
impact: Debug builds show an overflow stripe and release builds clip the bar whenever the week has spending.
expected_behavior: Bar plus label fit the fixed height.
validation: Layout arithmetic; not yet observed on device (no spending in the current window).
recommended_fix: APPLIED: reserve a fixed 12 px label slot and size bars from the remaining height.

title: Spam model is trained mostly on an unrelated SMS-chat corpus
evidence: Vocabulary dominated by Singlish chat tokens from the 5,572-row Kaggle set; real UPI data is 382 rows
On the owner's inbox a legitimate Indian Bank UPI Lite template scores exactly the 0.85 threshold
impact: Fragile on real bank formats; correctness depends on the high threshold.
recommended_fix: Retrain with more Indian bank/UPI data (synthetic or consented), re-validate on real inboxes.

title: Notification text is scored by SMS-trained models
evidence: evaluate('$title $text') on app notifications; training data is SMS only
impact: Out-of-distribution scoring; unvalidated (zero notification transactions ever captured on device).
recommended_fix: Collect consented notification samples and evaluate.

title: Empty input scores 0.0 where sklearn gives sigmoid(bias)
evidence: Deliberate shared guard; unreachable in practice
impact: None in practice.
recommended_fix: None; documented.

title: Dart inference is numerically identical to sklearn (negative finding)
evidence: Fixtures regenerated from sklearn's own TfidfVectorizer.transform differ from the previous ones by at most 2.2e-16
impact: The models themselves are not 'broken'.
recommended_fix: Do not change the inference maths.

title: Production model-load path had no test coverage
evidence: Every test used loadFromJsonStringForTest via dart:io; TfidfLogReg.load()/rootBundle never called
impact: Asset declaration or load regressions are invisible.
recommended_fix: APPLIED: test/services/ml/model_asset_loading_test.dart (proven to fail when an asset declaration is removed).

title: Parity fixtures were circular (Dart vs a Python copy of Dart)
evidence: Expected probabilities came from score_manual
impact: Shared drift from sklearn would pass.
recommended_fix: APPLIED: score_sklearn reference; generator fails if score_manual drifts by more than 1e-6.

title: Database tests exercise a hand-copied class, not LocalDatabase
evidence: TestableLocalDatabase duplicates schema and queries
impact: Production query changes are untested (e.g. the new getTransactionCount range).
expected_behavior: Test the real class against FFI SQLite.
recommended_fix: Inject the DatabaseFactory into LocalDatabase and test it directly.

title: No CI; strictest accuracy suites only run where gitignored data exists
evidence: Accuracy suites markTestSkipped without data/*.csv
impact: Regressions land unnoticed.
expected_behavior: CI on every push with synthetic accuracy corpus.
recommended_fix: Add CI (analyze + test).

title: Ingestion orchestration and Kotlin layer are untested
evidence: Only copied query logic of the provider is tested; no Kotlin tests
impact: C1, C7, C8 class defects are invisible to the suite.
recommended_fix: Extract ingestion into a testable service with injected channels.

title: Duplicate parser test file
evidence: Fully overlaps test/services/upi_parser_test.dart
impact: Maintenance cost.
recommended_fix: Delete the root-level copy.

title: TransactionProvider is a god object with duplicated ingestion code
evidence: Owns capture, ML gating, parsing, dedup, persistence, location, sync, widget push and UI state; record construction duplicated between live and history paths
impact: Hard to test (T5) and easy to diverge (location only on one path).
recommended_fix: Extract an IngestionService.

title: Kotlin sources live under com/example/receipt but declare package com.upitracker.app
evidence: Commit 8475ac2 changed package statements, namespace and applicationId but not the directory
impact: Cosmetic; misleading paths in docs.
recommended_fix: git mv to com/upitracker/app.

title: Status/success messages are carried in the `error` field
evidence: 'Found N new transactions' assigned to _error
impact: Confusing API.
recommended_fix: Separate status field.

title: A stale pre-rename build is still installed and capturing on the owner's device
evidence: Holds READ_SMS/RECEIVE_SMS, notification-listener access and ALLOW_BACKUP; runs the old code with S3/S4 leaks
impact: Duplicate capture, old vulnerable code active, possible confusion about which app is current.
recommended_fix: Uninstall com.example.receipt (owner action).

title: No code shrinking/obfuscation and unpinned targetSdk
evidence: No isMinifyEnabled; targetSdk = flutter.targetSdkVersion (36 with Flutter 3.41.6)
impact: Larger attack surface; target SDK changes silently with Flutter upgrades.
recommended_fix: Enable R8 for release; pin targetSdk.

title: Python training environment is not reproducible
evidence: Local .venv-ml has scikit-learn 1.9.0, numpy 2.5.1; nothing pinned in the repo
impact: Retraining may silently produce different models.
recommended_fix: Add requirements.txt with pinned versions.

title: Direct Dart dependencies behind latest, incl. the database driver
evidence: `flutter pub outdated`: postgres 3.5.9 → 3.5.19 (resolvable), permission_handler 11 → 13, geolocator 13 → 14, flutter_dotenv 5 → 6; 74 packages total have newer versions
impact: Missed fixes; no specific CVE was verified (no vulnerability database was available in this environment).
recommended_fix: Upgrade postgres within constraints first; schedule majors.

title: README claims sync is 'bidirectional-safe'
evidence: Sync is push-only (docs/features/sync.md is correct)
impact: Readers assume remote→local recovery exists.
recommended_fix: Corrected.

title: README describes the dedup key wrongly
evidence: Key is md5 of txn id → ref → normalised body; amount/window/counterparty is the separate fuzzy tier
impact: Misleads maintainers.
recommended_fix: Corrected.

title: Docs asserted capture broadcasts were 'internal' when they were system-wide
evidence: See S3
impact: A security property was documented that the code lacked.
recommended_fix: Code fixed so the docs are now accurate; wording made explicit.

title: 'Reads notifications and SMS in real time' — capture was off after every launch
evidence: See C1
impact: Users and maintainers believe capture is automatic.
recommended_fix: Code fixed; docs describe persistence, catch-up and the remaining notification gap.

title: '100% of real UPI SMS ingested' holds only on the training corpus
evidence: See C2: 12 real transactions dropped on an independent real inbox before the fix
impact: Overstated guarantee.
recommended_fix: Qualified in README.

title: Stale model sizes/feature counts
evidence: direction model is 38.1 KB / 731 features (README: 33.7 KB / 641); payload ~350 KB (doc: 344 KB)
recommended_fix: Corrected.

title: Held-out metrics conflict between README and docs/ml-training.md
evidence: Spam recall 0.917 vs 0.921; direction precision 0.958 vs 0.980; min P(transactional) 0.571 vs 0.615; '382 SMS' vs '381/381'
impact: Unknown which numbers describe the shipped models.
validation: Text comparison; not recomputed (would require retraining or rebuilding the exact split).
recommended_fix: Marked for human decision; regenerate from a pinned training run.

title: Training-mix and test-count details are wrong
evidence: SYNTHETIC_CREDITS is 20 (doc 21); CURATED_SPAM weighted ×2 (doc ×3); ~255 tests (actual 286 before this audit, 299 after); fixture counts 13/15/12 (actual 17/24/16)
recommended_fix: Corrected.

title: Unverifiable performance claim
evidence: '~98% of decisions short-circuit at layer 1 (~5 µs/message)' — no benchmark exists; the inbox sweep shows most UPI messages pass all layers
recommended_fix: Removed.

title: Debt backup feature and its storage/permissions were undocumented
evidence: No mention of DebtBackupService, file location or permissions
recommended_fix: Documented.

title: Every refresh loads the entire filtered transaction table
evidence: getAllTransactions is called without limit/offset after every insert, filter change and summary reload
impact: Linear growth of memory and refresh time with history size (each row carries raw SMS text).
recommended_fix: Paginate the list; load summaries via SQL only.

title: SMS history is read on the platform main thread
evidence: ContentResolver cursor loop runs synchronously inside the method-call handler (up to 500 rows)
impact: UI jank/ANR risk during scans, now also during startup catch-up (bounded by the watermark).
recommended_fix: Run the query on a background executor and post the result.

title: Fuzzy dedup re-parses every candidate's raw text per incoming message
evidence: UpiParser.parseSms on each candidate row; no index on (amount, transaction_type)
impact: O(candidates) regex work per message on the UI isolate.
recommended_fix: Persist balance/embedded time columns; add index.

title: Location lookup blocks live ingestion for up to 10 seconds
evidence: getCurrentLocation awaited inline with a 10 s timeLimit before insert
impact: Captured transactions appear late; may prompt for permission from a background event.
recommended_fix: Insert immediately and attach location asynchronously.

title: Sync uploads row by row with no batching or transaction; full re-push after integrity miss
evidence: One round trip per row; markAllUnsynced re-uploads the whole table; getUnsyncedTransactions has no LIMIT
impact: Slow, battery-heavy sync and partial remote writes on failure.
recommended_fix: Batch inserts in a transaction, page uploads.
